description: This Java class 'AlarmState' manages alarm processing logic within the Thingsboard rule engine, including alarm creation, updates, clearing, and messaging.

classes.name: AlarmState
classes.description: Manages alarm lifecycle, including creation, update, clearing, and messaging within the rule engine.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes incoming messages or timestamps to evaluate and update alarms accordingly.

methods.name: createOrClearAlarms
methods.description: Evaluates alarm rules and creates or clears alarms based on data and rule conditions.

methods.name: clearAlarmState
methods.description: Clears the specified alarm rule state.

methods.name: validateUpdate
methods.description: Validates if an update matches the alarm rule's keys and type.

methods.name: initCurrentAlarm
methods.description: Initializes the current alarm by fetching the latest active alarm if not already fetched.

methods.name: pushMsg
methods.description: Sends alarm creation, update, or clear messages to the message queue.

methods.name: setAlarmConditionMetadata
methods.description: Sets metadata related to alarm condition type and duration.

methods.name: updateState
methods.description: Updates internal alarm rule states based on persisted data.

methods.name: calculateAlarmResult
methods.description: Calculates and updates the alarm object based on rule evaluation results.

methods.name: createDetails
methods.description: Creates detailed alarm information, including data and dashboard ID.

methods.name: getValueAsString
methods.description: Converts EntityKeyValue to its string representation.

methods.name: processAlarmClear
methods.description: Handles alarm clear events, updating internal state accordingly.
